versions.changelog:
Initial release of Book Proposal Generator skill.

- Generates complete, agent-ready nonfiction book proposals in 4 modular prompts.
- Free prompt produces a detailed hook and overview; paid prompts cover market analysis, chapter outlines, and author platform with pitch materials.
- Clear input guidance, industry-standard structure, and real market positioning.
- Supports a range of nonfiction authors—business, self-help, memoir, and more.
- Includes pricing tiers from DIY ($29) to done-for-you ($197–$297) with fast turnaround.
- Outputs meet current industry standards for professional book proposals.
